blackhole.method: Real TCP proxy consumes and discards bytes in both directions after WS authentication and a valid application ping; it does not inject FIN/RST or close either peer before application lease detection.

blackhole.limitations: Observed timing includes test polling and normal event-loop scheduling. This is not a guarantee of pausing exactly 10 seconds after physical network loss.
